einzeiler: How Trump's immigration policy has shifted to limit all forms of immigration.
kurzfassung: President Trump has shifted federal immigration policy from curtailing illegal immigration to severely limiting all forms of immigration. The episode examines what changes have occurred and analyzes their impacts. Correspondents Miles Parks, Ximena Bustillo, and Franco Ordoñez discuss the developments.
stichpunkte: Campaign promises regarding illegal immigration to the United States
Shifts in federal immigration policy under President Trump
Severe limitations on all forms of immigration
Analysis of what has happened and the impacts of the policy changes
Discussion featuring Miles Parks, Ximena Bustillo, and Franco Ordoñez
beschreibung:
After campaigning on a platform to curtail illegal immigration to the United States, President Trump has shifted federal immigration policy to severely limit all forms of immigration. We look at what's happened, and what the impacts have been.

This episode: voting correspondent Miles Parks, immigration policy correspondent Ximena Bustillo, and White House correspondent Franco Ordoñez.

This podcast was produced and edited by Casey Morell and Bria Suggs.

Our executive producer is Muthoni Muturi.
